assets.title: Dynamic Surface Water Extent (Sentinel-1)
assets.summary: Sentinel-1 based dynamic surface water classification for event-scale flood context.
assets.when_to_use: Use for event-window surface-water evidence, especially when clouds may limit optical imagery.
assets.when_not_to_use: Do not use as a long-term water-frequency or permanent-water baseline.
assets.llm_recommendation_hint: Prioritize this layer when the event needs current inundation context or cloud-resilient water evidence.
assets.risk_notes: Coverage depends on Sentinel-1 acquisition timing inside the event window; class values need careful legend interpretation.

assets.title: Dynamic Surface Water Extent (HLS)
assets.summary: Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 dynamic surface water classification for event-scale flood context.
assets.when_to_use: Use when optical observations are useful for event-window water classification and visual cross-checking.
assets.when_not_to_use: Do not prioritize when heavy cloud cover is likely or when radar evidence is more reliable.
assets.llm_recommendation_hint: Recommend as an optical companion to Sentinel-1 when cloud risk is acceptable.
assets.risk_notes: Optical water classification can be degraded by cloud, haze, shadow, or sparse clear observations.

assets.title: JRC Monthly Water History
assets.summary: Monthly classified water history for contextualizing persistent and transient inundation patterns.
assets.when_to_use: Use to compare event water against the normal monthly surface-water pattern.
assets.when_not_to_use: Do not use as a direct event flood-detection layer.
assets.llm_recommendation_hint: Recommend when the analysis needs to distinguish possible floodwater from typical monthly water presence.
assets.risk_notes: Monthly classification is contextual and may not match the exact event day.

assets.title: JRC Monthly Water Recurrence
assets.summary: Monthly recurrence percentage for reading how frequently water appears in the selected month.
assets.when_to_use: Use to identify where water is commonly present in the same month and avoid over-reading normal seasonal water as floodwater.
assets.when_not_to_use: Do not use to claim event-day inundation extent.
assets.llm_recommendation_hint: Recommend as a frequency baseline when seasonal water recurrence matters for interpretation.
assets.risk_notes: Recurrence is a climatological-style context layer, not a direct flood observation.

assets.title: JRC Yearly Water Classification
assets.summary: Annual water classification for separating permanent water from seasonal water at yearly scale.
assets.when_to_use: Use to separate permanent or seasonal water background from likely event-driven inundation.
assets.when_not_to_use: Do not use as a precise event-date flood mask.
assets.llm_recommendation_hint: Recommend when the map needs a stable water baseline for interpreting flood detection results.
assets.risk_notes: Yearly classes are coarser than event timing and should be treated as background context.

assets.title: HydroATLAS Basins L6
assets.summary: Global basin boundaries for hydrologic context around the confirmed AOI.
assets.when_to_use: Use to explain the hydrologic basin context around the selected AOI.
assets.when_not_to_use: Do not use as a flood extent or water occurrence layer.
assets.llm_recommendation_hint: Recommend when the user needs basin-scale interpretation or upstream/downstream context.
assets.risk_notes: Basin boundaries support interpretation but do not indicate observed flooding.

assets.title: Free-Flowing Rivers
assets.summary: Major free-flowing river network for hydrologic context and basin interpretation.
assets.when_to_use: Use to show river-network context near the AOI and relate flooding to nearby channels.
assets.when_not_to_use: Do not use as a water extent or flood-detection layer.
assets.llm_recommendation_hint: Recommend when river proximity and drainage interpretation are important.
assets.risk_notes: River network context may not include all local drainage or urban channels.
